preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
Each test case must have an integer N between 3 and 100,000.
The sum of all N values across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: If N is less than 4, output -1. Otherwise, output a valid permutation P of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(P[i] ^ P[i+1] != P[i+2] for i in range(N-2))
postconditions.description: For each valid permutation P, the XOR of adjacent elements must not equal the next element.

postconditions.expression: len(set(P)) == N and min(P) == 1 and max(P) == N
postconditions.description: The permutation P must contain all integers from 1 to N exactly once.
